### 2026-10-18: I added a second track to my marble track! This one loops around, goes down stairs, and ends at the plinko from the first track. Here is the final result:

**5h**

I added a second track to my marble track! This one loops around, goes down stairs, and ends at the plinko from the first track. Here is the final result:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 3.51.39 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/5d117c8cb205a3e513f55d71f7a415f1bb7687d874ddd5da2169bd2cbb0ad8d0.png)

This is what the sketch of my stairs looked like:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 3.23.02 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/cf8a32349e84e02ecad1691da24144b94b5803f574c7e4cca6cbd4b70dfc4e9c.png)

I also had to make 2 separate tracks, one for the beginning of the track and another for the end, with the stairs connecting them. Here is the first one:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 3.14.59 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/7744e01e47ccb3307455c1c3deb16502fdf4c9109cbbfaff9568e7f62782bf15.png)

(I forgot to take a picture before I did the sweep). Here is the second one:

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 3.41.25 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/85a804c9b7ce4c0a557e566575f7903970a621891b6e1570ec2b50c9a218531b.png)

Some issues I had was the track being too low, and so it would go into the plinko instead of going on top of it. This took some time to fix, with adjusting the plinko angle and the angles and heights of the track. I wanted the track to be steep but not go right into the plinko board. Finally, I made the ball (I almost forgot to do this)!

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 4.12.33 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/7ME5CuFiz5X4u2KxuO278yO001rQ8Db2/54d6b9053784dee15440f37c89adc3e2e39b4ad7801e177caf43a9a50a875cf2.png)

After everything, I made some minor tweaks to things like the funnel, stairs, and plinko board to improve it. One thing I couldn't figure out was how to extrude the base of the plinko board without making another sketch. Last session I solved this by making another sketch and extruding that, but this session I tried doing it without that extra sketch but couldn't figure it out, so I left it as is. Overall, I'm happy with the result, and there's a good chance this is what I will submit.
